name: github
description: GitHub-hosted collaboration skills on top of the baseline, all driven by the gh CLI: reviewing-dependabot-prs (classify and batch-merge open Dependabot PRs), triaging-scan-alerts (triage open code-scanning alerts to file:line, report only), and watching-pr-checks (check a PR's CI status and hand off to a project's own /triaging-ci on a real failure). No hooks, no gate, no workflows: the Claude Code GitHub Action workflows are the separate `claude-github` pack.
adoptNotes: The three skills need only `gh` CLI auth (already required by every other gh-CLI-based skill this baseline ships) and install anywhere a .claude/ directory exists. triaging-scan-alerts reads code-scanning alerts, and nothing in the baseline or this pack produces them: turn on GitHub's CodeQL default setup for the repository (Settings > Code security), or install the `supply-chain` pack, whose scorecard.yml uploads SARIF, otherwise the skill's first call returns "code scanning is not enabled" and reports nothing. watching-pr-checks' handoff to /triaging-ci degrades gracefully if the project doesn't have that skill installed -- it still reports the real failure, just without the handoff. The Claude Code GitHub Action workflows (claude.yml, claude-pr-review.yml) used to ship in this pack and are now the separate `claude-github` pack; a project that installed this pack before the split keeps those files untouched.
